segments.title: Return to the Eldeners: Shadow of the Erdtree Playthrough
segments.notes: Case Blackwell cold-opens with Pepito, then spends the broadcast re-acclimating to Elden Ring's DLC after a Hollow Knight hiatus; explores the Land of Shadow, defeats Dry Leaf Dane and Rugalia the Great Red Bear, and clears Messmer the Impaler in a two-phase fight before signing off for a meeting.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a solo gaming broadcast, re-learning Elden Ring controls and clearing Messmer the Impaler.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers the top-of-hour cold open before handing off to Case for the gameplay session.

lore_notes.fact: Has been playing Hollow Knight on Switch, causing muscle-memory confusion with Elden Ring controls (A/B button swap).
Defeats Dry Leaf Dane in a friendly duel and acquires Dane's hat (Sun-faded and Lightly Soiled Hat).
Defeats Rugalia, Great Red Bear, and acquires Roar of Rugalia incantation and Gravebird Black Quill Armor.
Defeats Messmer the Impaler in two phases after multiple attempts, using Mimic Tear and a summoned cooperator.
Mentions a meeting in 20 minutes and suggests a possible return stream on Friday.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns to the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC after a hiatus, re-learning controls while exploring the Land of Shadow. He defeats Dry Leaf Dane and the Great Red Bear Rugalia before ultimately conquering Messmer the Impaler in a two-phase battle, then concludes the broadcast with a raid.
